about: One row per Overtime perk. Each row generates one PerkDef (with its FxDef list) in src/Generated/Sheets.g.cs, run by the generic perk engine (src/Engine). No perk changes the score. Card art reuses the player's own Hangtime! card sprites; the card tint is the element color.

columns.title: card title
columns.rarity: common | rare | epic (card weight 3 / 2 / 1; vanilla cards weigh 2)
columns.triggers: triggers.json ids this perk listens to
columns.conds: condition values (keys from the trigger's conds; chance 1 and cooldown 0 mean always)
columns.fx: effects: each has on (trigger), when (stage), fx (effects.json id) and that effect's params
columns.art_from: vanilla Technique class whose card sprite is reused
columns.opponent_ok: yes if opponent teams may be given it
columns.verified: how it was seen working in the running game, or 'no'

vanilla_cards_seen.about: Technique classes on the game's upgrade-screen card list (logged in game, 2026-10-08). art_from must be one of these.

rows.title: Blaze Spike
rows.description: Spikes burst into flame: a little extra power and a fire trail.

rows.title: Afterburner
rows.description: After your spike crosses the net it keeps speeding up, trailing fire.
rows.verified: partial: triggered in the user's own play under v0.1 (same behavior); engine rewrite not yet replayed

rows.title: Scorched Earth
rows.description: Your spikes burn hotter, and where they dig one the court catches fire and slows receivers.

rows.title: Flame Serve
rows.description: Serves catch fire as they cross the net and speed up.

rows.title: Ember Tip
rows.description: Tips rain embers: defenders run on burning feet as the tip arrives, and the court smoulders.

rows.title: Phoenix Dive
rows.description: Your digs rise like a phoenix: extra height, and your counter-spike burns hotter.

rows.title: Inferno
rows.description: After 3 good touches in a row you ignite: much stronger spikes for 6 seconds.

rows.title: Frost Serve
rows.description: Serves freeze for a split second after the net, then rush on.

rows.title: Black Ice
rows.description: Your spikes skid in on ice: a little faster, and the first bump against them slides off at an odd angle.

rows.title: Permafrost
rows.description: Frost spreads where they dig your spikes: receivers on the ice move slower.

rows.title: Frozen Wall
rows.description: A strong block freezes the other team's footwork for a moment.

rows.title: Cold Snap
rows.description: Sometimes your spike freezes solid in mid-air, then shatters forward faster.

rows.title: Zig-Zag Spike
rows.description: Your spikes zig-zag like lightning after the net.

rows.title: Thunderclap
rows.description: Your spike can strike their blocker with lightning, stunning them for a moment.

rows.title: Lightning Reflex
rows.description: After a dig you're charged up: quicker feet for the rest of the play.

rows.title: Storm Serve
rows.description: Serves often crackle and jitter right after the net.

rows.title: Thunder God
rows.description: After 6 good touches in a row, lightning stuns the whole other team.

rows.title: Moon Set
rows.description: After your team's set or bump, the ball floats like it's on the moon.
rows.verified: partial: triggered in the user's own play under v0.1 (same behavior); engine rewrite not yet replayed

rows.title: Swerve Tip
rows.description: Your tips start short, then swerve deep into the court.

rows.title: Dipping Serve
rows.description: Your serves dive down sharply once they cross the net.
rows.verified: partial: triggered in the user's own play under v0.1 (same behavior); engine rewrite not yet replayed

rows.title: Gale Serve
rows.description: A gust hits your serve at the net, knocking it up or down.

rows.title: Tailwind
rows.description: A constant tailwind: you run 6% faster.

rows.title: Cyclone Spike
rows.description: Your spike hops up over their arms, then dives.

rows.title: Tidal Arc
rows.description: Spikes ride a wave after the net: a rolling arc that's hard to read.

rows.title: Mirror Image
rows.description: Your spike often splits into a watery afterimage. The other team may chase the fake.

rows.title: Undertow
rows.description: Your spikes roll like a wave, and digs against them get dragged toward their back line.

rows.title: Mist Veil
rows.description: Your serve vanishes into mist for a moment after the net.

rows.title: Tsunami
rows.description: A high spike becomes a tidal wave: big power, and it swamps their footwork.

rows.title: Quake Spike
rows.description: Spikes land like a quake: the court shakes under the defenders as the ball comes in.

rows.title: Bedrock Block
rows.description: Rock-solid blocks: you reach a bit higher, and the ball rebounds off you faster.

rows.title: Boulder Serve
rows.description: Heavy serves: they hit harder, and the first bump against them comes up short.

rows.title: Tectonic Slam
rows.description: Sometimes your spike splits the court and knocks the other team off balance.

rows.title: Mud Trap
rows.description: Tips land in mud: the defender gets stuck as the tip comes in, and the court stays muddy.

rows.title: Shadow Ball
rows.description: Your spike fades into shadow for a moment after the net.

rows.title: Night Serve
rows.description: Serves slip into darkness just past the net.

rows.title: Eclipse
rows.description: Sometimes the lights go out on your spike: it vanishes and a decoy flies the other way.

rows.title: Solar Flare
rows.description: Your spikes flash like the sun, blinding the other team for a split second.

rows.title: Radiant Set
rows.description: Your setter's sets glow gold; spike them in time for extra power.

rows.title: Holy Lance
rows.description: A spike from high up can become a lance of light: much faster.

rows.title: Halo Dig
rows.description: When you dig, a halo guides your setter: they rush to the ball faster.

rows.title: Aura Burst
rows.description: After 4 good touches in a row, a golden aura boosts spike, jump and speed for 6 seconds.
rows.flavour: This isn't even my final form.

rows.title: Afterimage
rows.description: You leave afterimages as you run, move a bit faster, and sometimes your spike fakes out the defense.

rows.title: Time Stop Set
rows.description: Your setter's set can freeze time: everything slows and you line up a stronger spike.

rows.title: Cut-In Spike
rows.description: Hang in the air long enough and your spike gets a dramatic close-up and extra power.

rows.title: Phantom Serve
rows.description: Your serve splits into a decoy and the real ball.

rows.title: Gravity Drop
rows.description: Sometimes your spike stops dead past the net and plunges straight down.

rows.title: Overdrive
rows.description: A dig powers you up: your next spike within 6 seconds hits much harder.

rows.title: Monster Block
rows.description: Higher block jumps, and a strong block sends out a shockwave that stuns the hitter.

rows.title: Second Wind
rows.description: When the other team is one point from winning, you get a burst of speed and jump.

rows.title: Showboat
rows.description: Every tip pumps you up: your next spike within 9 seconds gets extra power.

rows.title: Iron Will
rows.description: Your block jumps go higher.

rows.title: Kaiju Leap
rows.description: Jump from a full run for a monster leap.

rows.title: Meteor Smash
rows.description: A spike from way up comes down like a meteor; digging it barely gets the ball up.

rows.title: Rival Spirit
rows.description: When they win two rallies in a row, your next spike hits back harder.

rows.title: Zone Focus
rows.description: In the zone: sometimes a dig slows time and sharpens your counter-spike.

rows.title: Spirit Serve
rows.description: Hold the ball for a moment before serving to charge a much faster spirit serve.

rows.title: Echo Tip
rows.description: Your tip leaves an echo that fakes out the defense.

rows.title: Hot Streak
rows.description: Each point you win in a row makes your spikes stronger.

rows.title: Bank Shot
rows.description: Every bump and set banks power. Your next spike cashes it all in.

rows.title: Collector
rows.description: Your spikes get stronger for every ability you own.

rows.title: Overclock
rows.description: Stronger spikes, but the whole game runs faster.

rows.title: Libero Dive
rows.description: Diving digs pop the ball up and you spring back to your feet faster.

rows.title: Read the Play
rows.description: When they spike, you read it: a burst of speed to get to the ball.

rows.title: Guardian Wall
rows.description: Often a golden wall slows their spike down so you can dig it.

rows.title: Shadow Step
rows.description: When they spike, you slip through the shadows toward the ball.

rows.title: Tidal Wall
rows.description: Their spikes usually hit a wall of water and lose speed.

rows.title: Radiant Guard
rows.description: Their spikes make your team glow: better blocks and quicker feet for a moment.

rows.title: Iron Curtain
rows.description: Higher block jumps, and strong blocks rattle the other team.

rows.title: Ice Wall
rows.description: Icy block jumps reach a bit higher; strong blocks freeze the ball, then fire it back.

rows.title: Quick Set
rows.description: Fast-tempo sets: your next spike hits a little harder.

rows.title: Back Set
rows.description: Your setter sometimes fakes the direction, leaving their blocker frozen.

rows.title: Tempo Master
rows.description: Your setter controls the tempo: time slows and your spike gets a big boost.

rows.title: Tornado Set
rows.description: Your setter's sets ride an updraft, and you jump higher to meet them.

rows.title: Jump Float
rows.description: Your serves float and dance unpredictably after the net.

rows.title: Meteor Serve
rows.description: Hold the ball, then serve a blazing meteor that dives after the net.

rows.title: Line Shot
rows.description: Half your spikes bend toward their back line.

rows.title: Thunder Serve
rows.description: Serves can strike their receiver with lightning as they cross the net.

rows.title: Wildfire
rows.description: After 5 good touches in a row, fire sweeps the other team's court and slows them.

rows.title: Earthquake Serve
rows.description: Your serve often shakes the ground as it crosses, freezing the other team.

rows.title: Aftershock
rows.description: Digging your spike leaves their hitter dazed for over a second, spoiling their counter.

rows.title: Overheat
rows.description: You run hot all match: +24% spike power, but 3% slower.

rows.title: Glacier Body
rows.description: Solid as a glacier: +18% block, but 3% slower.

rows.title: Featherweight
rows.description: Light as air: +10% jump, but weaker blocks.

rows.title: Stone Skin
rows.description: Tough skin: better blocks and sturdier digs, slightly softer spikes.

rows.title: Counter Attack
rows.description: When they spike, you get fired up: a quick step toward the ball, and your next spike within 6 seconds hits harder.

rows.title: Lightning Rod
rows.description: When they spike, lightning strikes back: their whole team flinches and their setter is frozen for 2.5 seconds (no block on your counter).

rows.title: Spirit Bond
rows.description: You and your setter move as one after every set.

rows.title: Phantom Block
rows.description: Your block jumps leave shadowy copies and reach higher.

rows.title: Sharpshooter
rows.description: Some of your spikes bend toward the corners.

rows.title: Cannonball Serve
rows.description: Hold the ball for a moment, then fire a cannonball serve.

rows.title: Rally Master
rows.description: After 5 good touches in a row, you dominate the rest of the rally: spike, speed and block all up.

rows.title: Volcano Slam
rows.description: A high spike can erupt: much faster, and the court burns where they dig it.

rows.title: Blizzard
rows.description: After 5 good touches in a row, a blizzard slows the other team for a few seconds.

rows.title: Typhoon Serve
rows.description: Sometimes your serve becomes a typhoon, bending and rolling after the net.

rows.title: Abyss Spike
rows.description: Sometimes your spike sinks into the deep: it fades, then dives.

rows.title: Starfall
rows.description: Sometimes your spike falls like a star: a blinding flash, then a steep dive.

rows.title: Clutch Gene
rows.description: When they're one point from winning, your spikes and blocks get much stronger.

rows.title: Last Breath
rows.description: When they're one point from winning, darkness falls: the other team is slowed for the rest of the rally.

rows.title: Underdog
rows.description: After they win two rallies in a row, you get angry: stronger spikes and quicker feet for a while.

rows.title: Spring Heels
rows.description: Every jump gets a little extra spring.

rows.title: Skyhook
rows.description: Jump from a run and you soar with a halo under your feet.

rows.title: Feint Tip
rows.description: Your tips fake one way and flicker out of sight.

rows.title: Dink Master
rows.description: Your tips drop like stones just past the net.

rows.title: Wind Tip
rows.description: A gust carries your tips: faster, and they bob unpredictably.

rows.title: Iron Serve
rows.description: Weighty serves: slightly faster, and they knock the first bump down.

rows.title: Ace Instinct
rows.description: Often you find the perfect serve: faster, and hard to track.

rows.title: Frost Nova
rows.description: A strong block bursts into a frost nova: the hitter freezes and their team slows down.

rows.title: Chain Lightning
rows.description: Sometimes your spike arcs through the whole team, and the lightning lingers on their hitter.

rows.title: Tidal Surge
rows.description: Your setter's sets ride a wave, carrying extra force into your spike.

rows.title: Sunburst Serve
rows.description: Serves flare like the sun at the net, dazzling the receivers.

rows.title: Gravity Well
rows.description: Often their spike gets caught in a gravity well: it stalls and loses half its power.

rows.title: Umbral Block
rows.description: Your block jumps rise from the shadows a little higher; blocks vanish for a moment, and their team hesitates.

rows.title: Shade Dig
rows.description: After a dig you melt into the shadows: faster feet for the rest of the play, and your next spike hits a little harder.

rows.title: Ice Skates
rows.description: You glide across the court: a little faster all match, but your jumps are slightly lower.

rows.title: Chill Touch
rows.description: Your sets send a chill over the net: their defenders slow down while your attack comes in.

rows.title: Ripple Dig
rows.description: Your digs float up on a ripple and your setter rides the current to the ball.

rows.title: Splash Block
rows.description: Your block jumps spring a little higher; blocks splash over their side, and their team wades through it.

rows.title: Glint
rows.description: Sometimes your spike catches the light and dazzles their defenders.

rows.title: Guiding Light
rows.description: Every set lights the way: your next jump goes a little higher.

rows.title: Tengu Gale
rows.description: Sometimes the tengu's fan joins your spike: it's faster, swerves wildly, and the wind pins their team.

rows.title: Flow State
rows.description: Six clean touches in a row and everything clicks: stronger spikes, higher jumps and quicker feet for a while.

rows.title: Frost Fang
rows.description: The wolf bites: whoever touches your spike first is frozen solid for a second.

rows.title: Beetle Horn
rows.description: Your block jumps spring higher, and blocks come off like a beetle's horn toss: faster, and their dig goes astray.

rows.title: Foxfire Feint
rows.description: Sometimes your spike splits into foxfire and their defense chases the wrong ball.

rows.title: Grounded Receive
rows.description: Rooted digs pop a little higher, and your setter gets there faster.

rows.title: Lightning Step
rows.description: Jump off a run and lightning carries you: higher, and quicker on the landing.

rows.title: Nine Tails
rows.description: Sometimes the nine-tailed fox shows itself: your spike splits into illusions and fades from sight.

rows.title: Hercules Block
rows.description: Block jumps with the strength of the Hercules beetle: a strong block comes off faster and knocks their whole team off balance.
